user.title: Voetbal.nl – Login
user.description: Enter your voetbal.nl (KNVB Account) email address and password. The integration logs in automatically and refreshes the session every 6 days in the background.

team.title: Voetbal.nl – Select team
team.description: Enter the name of the team you want to track. Optionally paste the team URL from voetbal.nl ({example_url}) to skip the search.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Voetbal.nl
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your voetbal.nl credentials again to restore access.

error.auth_failed: Invalid email address or password. Please check your voetbal.nl credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to voetbal.nl. Please check your internet connection, or try again later if voetbal.nl has an outage.
error.team_not_found: Team not found. Try providing the direct team URL.
error.invalid_team_url: This is not a voetbal.nl team URL. Use a link like {example_url}.

data_description.team_url: Leave empty to use the URL from setup.
